submitted.rationale: Every measured composition showed EQE at the noise floor (about ±0.002%). That fits Zn–Sb oxides like ZnSb2O6 and Zn7Sb2O12, which have wide band gaps (>3 eV) and should absorb almost nothing at 2.1 eV illumination. Index 9 (Sb 0.50) gave the highest reading, 0.00033%, but it is not meaningfully different from the others.

rejected.reason: EQE -0.0004%, near the ZnSb2O6 trirutile composition, wide band gap
